practices.normalizedSummary: Release artifacts should carry independently verifiable provenance bound to the exact build inputs and workflow identity.
practices.evidenceRequirement: clean release artifact pipeline and signing key policy are implemented
practices.activationTrigger: release packaging reaches the packaged-deployed maturity transition
practices.reversalCondition: disable attestation promotion when verifier, identity or key authority is unresolved
practices.rationale: SEC already models Evidence identity, but public artifact attestation belongs to a later release slice.

practices.normalizedSummary: Build actions must declare all semantic inputs, tools, environment and outputs instead of reading ambient host state.
practices.evidenceRequirement: existing Host, Toolchain, Target and Evidence closure contracts remain enforced
practices.rationale: SEC already separates Host, Toolchain, Target and exact Evidence inputs.

practices.normalizedSummary: A cache entry is reusable only when its complete input identity and deterministic output contract are unchanged.
practices.evidenceRequirement: existing cache keys, invalidation and clean parity tests remain authoritative
practices.rationale: SEC already treats cache as acceleration rather than Evidence or authority.

practices.normalizedSummary: Sensitive repository surfaces should require designated owners, and the ownership definition itself must be protected by the same or stronger rule.
practices.evidenceRequirement: fork-safe CODEOWNERS and ruleset contract with protected owner files
practices.activationTrigger: public collaboration policy, trusted review worktree and fork-safe CI are implemented
practices.reversalCondition: remove owner enforcement if repository rules cannot prove canonical owner identity
practices.rationale: SEC has semantic owners but has not completed public GitHub CODEOWNERS and ruleset deployment.

practices.normalizedSummary: Configuration should be validated as composable constraints with explicit conflicts instead of being repaired by precedence or defaults.
practices.evidenceRequirement: three unrelated configuration domains, conflict diagnostics and canonical revision tests
practices.activationTrigger: a real multi-framework configuration consumer exists
practices.reversalCondition: retire the generalized constraint layer if it obscures domain ownership or deterministic diagnostics
practices.rationale: SEC needs this only where configuration becomes a real canonical workspace domain.

practices.normalizedSummary: IR operations, types and verification constraints should be defined declaratively where that removes duplicated handwritten switches.
practices.evidenceRequirement: single registry drives builder, validator, projection and negative tests without a second schema owner
practices.activationTrigger: repeated handwritten IR switches are proven to drift in a real compiler slice
practices.reversalCondition: return to explicit typed code if declarative definitions reduce type safety or diagnostic precision
practices.rationale: SEC already wants one predicate and protocol owner; declarative generation should be adopted only where it reduces real duplication.

practices.normalizedSummary: Dependency additions and version changes should expose license, vulnerability and transitive supply-chain deltas before integration.
practices.evidenceRequirement: fork-safe dependency review, immutable lock authority and negative tests
practices.activationTrigger: public collaboration and dependency update workflow are active
practices.reversalCondition: disable automatic blocking if provider data is incomplete and fall back to explicit unresolved state
practices.rationale: SEC has provider governance but has not finished hosted dependency review.

practices.normalizedSummary: High-value pure parsers and validators should expose narrow deterministic fuzz targets and retain minimized failures as regression inputs.
practices.evidenceRequirement: bounded fuzz harness, deterministic seed replay, minimized corpus and ordinary regression promotion
practices.activationTrigger: Verification kernels stabilize enough that fuzzing no longer churns with every contract edit
practices.reversalCondition: remove a fuzz target when its oracle is ambiguous or failures cannot be replayed deterministically
practices.rationale: Useful for validators and identity kernels, but it must not enter the ordinary save loop.

practices.normalizedSummary: Independent review should bind exact candidate and scope, require reproducible evidence for blocking defects, and mark advisory or nit feedback as non-blocking.
practices.evidenceRequirement: exact-head finding schema, stale review invalidation, scope completeness and blocking-policy tests
practices.activationTrigger: Issue 252 focused Work Package is activated after the Agent trust-root stack is adopted
practices.reversalCondition: revert the typed policy if it weakens canonical invariants or prevents reviewers from reporting real uncertainty
practices.rationale: SEC needs auditable Review without turning preference or external prose into merge authority.

practices.normalizedSummary: Critical writer, recovery and distributed state machines should receive an executable or model-checked specification when tests cannot cover the full interleaving space.
practices.evidenceRequirement: model maps to code states and fault boundaries with counterexample replay
practices.activationTrigger: a stable high-risk state machine has repeated concurrency or recovery defects
practices.reversalCondition: retire the model if it diverges from code and no automated conformance bridge can be maintained
practices.rationale: Formal methods are justified only for stable critical kernels, not all product code.

practices.normalizedSummary: Released versions are immutable and version semantics begin only after the public API is explicitly declared.
practices.evidenceRequirement: release and compatibility owners continue to distinguish public API, build, package and support maturity
practices.rationale: SEC already separates compatibility, release artifacts and support claims.

practices.normalizedSummary: Every governed build or mutation step should distinguish inputs, outputs, acting authority and the activity that transformed them.
practices.evidenceRequirement: round-trip provenance graph, exact actor authority, materials/products closure and privacy tests
practices.activationTrigger: Verification V4 and mutation transaction identities are stable in main
practices.reversalCondition: remove generalized provenance edges that duplicate domain-specific truth or leak sensitive data
practices.rationale: SEC already separates several identity domains but needs one cross-domain reference vocabulary.

practices.normalizedSummary: A compiler platform should use multiple abstraction levels with explicit domain ownership rather than forcing all semantics into one universal IR.
practices.evidenceRequirement: existing Federation and domain IR boundaries remain enforced
practices.rationale: SEC already rejects a universal IR and keeps canonical semantic truth separate from target IRs.
